replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
https://youtu.be/eP6ddRpA93E

If you're wondering about the combo clips, the way autoclicker works in 1.8 is if you jitter or butterfly click (just legitimately clicking in general) then it has the same swing pattern while hitting a player as if you were hitting the air. On the other hand, if you use an autoclicker of any kind, it creates a different sword swing pattern as you demonstrated in the video. It is 100% accurate from my knowledge, so if you can prove that wrong on 1.8, go ahead. 

Secondly, you clearly hit blocks multiple times without getting particles, which is another sign of autoclicker, once again, 100% accurate. This method has been used for quite a while in MC to detect autoclickers. 

I don't really think you can prove this wrong, but you can try to explain if you want.

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
Quick explanation of autoclickers in 1.8: 

When autoclicking in 1.8, your swing animation changes. When you are playing legit, the animation is the same hitting a player as it is hitting air or a block.

In my video evidence, the animation was different and had the autoclicker animation, and in the handcam it was default 1.8 animation. This shows that you were even more likely autoclicking then. I did warn you pre-handcam, so yeah.
